_note: A Svelte-4 TypeScript component with a `<slot>` had its props wrapped in `Partial<…>`, so a consumer omitting a required prop passed silently. Upstream's `__sveltets_2_PropsWithChildren` only adds `children?: any` (for a default slot) and never makes the props optional for a TS file; the missing `title` is reported. Upstream anchors this TS2322 at the last character of the tag name (a source-map artefact of its generated call text); ours lands on the tag name's first character, where upstream also puts the TS2741 of a slot-less component.
